main_text.p: la pio confecrarit, appen-sis fubinde nouis coronis totum atteret: atq; adeo ipse quotidie unguentis oblinitur. Sanè ctiam, quæ pertinent ad curam magistratus quos prytaneos vocant, ipse diligenter curare solet: quò pofsit, ubi litatum fuerit, rem populo renuntiare. Itaque candidatus & coronatus in cōcionem prodit, & infit, Nos prytanei, ô Athenie-ses, Matri Deûm sacra recte fecimus, & litauimus: vos igitur omnia faufta exspectate. His ita renuntiatis, domum revertitur: deinde uxori narrat sibi prosperè supra modum res succedere. χαλκοῦ ἐν σκληπτῷ, τε τειβξιν σεφα[?] ἀλείφεως ὀσ[?] ἀμίλει ἢ ᾧ σ[?] κίνσας ως[?] ῳρυζάνεων ὅ[?] παγείλη τῳ[?] ᾧ ἰεφ. ᾧ σιδυασαμένῳ[?] φρὸν ἱμαπον[?] φανωμένῳ, τ[?] θεὼν εἰσεῖν, ω[?] Ἀθηναῖοι, ἐ[?] οἱ ῳρυταγὲς[?] τῇ μητρὶ τῶν[?] ἀξια ᾧ καλὰ[?] μεῖς ἐδιξεσθ[?] χαθά. ᾧ ζ[?] παγείλας, ἀπ[?] ηησας οἴκ[?] ἑαυτὸ γυναι[?] καθ' ἑαρξολ[?] ἡμερᾶι. τὰ Α- ἵστορ ἐκ ποιοῦντα. ἡμέρᾳ. ωσδοι- ἀ τῶν ὡς ἀ- δήμῳ ὥσδα- λαμ- ἐστε- παρελ- ἄνδρες ὑόμῳ ἰσεᾷ θεῶν ὁ υ- τὰ ἀ- ὅτα ἀ- τῶν δι- ἀδὲ τῇ ὡς λῶ δι-

page.notes: The first word of the page, "la", is uncertain; it may be a fragment of a longer word or an abbreviation. "faufta" is kept as printed. The running head is set in spaced capitals. Only the left part of each line is legible; the right edge of the strip is cut off, so line ends are incomplete and many words are doubtful. Line breaks are as seen in the scan; I could not tell whether any of them is a paragraph break, so the text is given as one paragraph. The ᾧ forms are read as abbreviated δέ and are uncertain. The small dark mark at the bottom right is not printed text and is left out. Greek lines are fragments cut at the left edge of the strip; the readings marked nowhere are read from a narrow, partly obscured strip and several words (the opening letters of each line, accents and breathings) are uncertain and should be checked against the full page: [?] is omitted here because the entire column is doubtful. The first paragraph is cont="true" as the text continues from the previous part.
